time/iso#

Strict ISO 8601 calendar and local-date-time representations.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Date(year: 2026, month: 8, day: 11).string();   // "2026-08-11"

IsoText("2026-08-11T12:30:45.125").local_date_time();

Description#

Strict ISO 8601 calendar and local-date-time representations.

Dates are exactly YYYY-MM-DD. Local date-times require an uppercase T and seconds: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS with an optional fraction of one through nine digits. Canonical output omits a zero fraction and trims trailing zeroes. Whitespace, offsets, zones, lowercase t, reduced precision and expanded years are rejected. Offset-bearing timestamps belong to time/rfc3339.
